snippet.title: Gothic Classic | Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Gothic Classic is now available for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S, but the return to Myrtana has only just begun.

Gothic II Complete Classic will arrive on September 29 on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S.

Gothic 3 Classic will follow on November 24 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2.

#Gothic #THQNordic2026
